summary: The kubelite restart handler waits for readiness: /readyz on apiserver nodes; on workers, the node's own Ready=True with a heartbeat after the restart (2a15ede). Per the ruling, renew-internal-tls.yml now renews the k8s leaves in a separate last play under serial: 1, so a not-ready node stops the roll (d393616). A stand-in harness under the real playbook confirmed the roll stops there, other groups are unaffected and --limit k8s_dev still works; the ansible gate is green and the done-record is committed (def4e31). Close-out N2 records that a sidecar env probe printed the ansible-vault password into this session's output.
